title: Nonlinear current dynamics and radial regularisation in the stationary Landau problem
summary: We investigate the stationary amplitude and current properties of a charged particle in a uniform magnetic field within the Bohm--Madelung formulation. The analysis is organised around two complementary questions: the effect of steady currents on amplitude evolution, and the influence of the singular radial behaviour on the energy spectrum of the Landau problem. For the zero-current system, corresponding to the standard Landau problem, the Hamilton--Jacobi equations lead to an Ermakov--Pinney reference structure for the separated amplitudes.
